name: wtfgif

scripts.build: npx tsc wtfgif.ts --outDir . --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck && npx esbuild wtfgif.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=wtfgif --outfile=wtfgif-browser.js

author: Matt Popovich
description: A drop-in optimized replacement for omggif: - Fused LZW decode→blit - 32-bit palette, Uint32 stores - Interlace pass scheduling - Typed-array open-addressing hash for encoder
